purpose: Failure modes per setup. This is the fuel for the mandatory Devil's Advocate field. A signal without a stated failure mode is an advertisement, not an analysis.
rule: Prompt-level requirement: name at least one failure mode from this list for the setup being scored. The deterministic gate enforces presence, a 20-character minimum, and rejects literal generic cop-outs ('markets can go down'). It cannot verify list membership without a setup id, so treat membership as a review/eval check, not a gate guarantee.

trend_pullback.consequence: Pullback becomes a reversal. The 50DMA break is the last exit.

signs: 5th or later pullback in the same leg
trend_pullback.consequence: Stop is far below, so position size shrinks and the trade is not worth the risk.

signs: pullback low formed on a gap down
trend_pullback.consequence: Stop sits at an untested level and gets swept.

signs: breakout on a gap, not on a close
range_breakout.consequence: Price re-enters the range within 3 sessions. This is the base rate, not the exception.
Volume was a one-off event, not accumulation. The move mean-reverts.

range_breakout.mode: Range top is also major resistance
signs: range top coincides with 200DMA or a prior all-time high
range_breakout.consequence: Two resistance layers stack; breakout needs disproportionate volume.

base_breakout.consequence: Not a real contraction. Supply was never absorbed.
Buyers from the failed base sell into strength.
Binary event. The technical stop does not protect against a gap.

signs: breadth deteriorating while the leader holds
rs_leader_pullback.consequence: Leaders fall last and hardest in a market top.
The pullback is the exit liquidity for earlier buyers.

signs: RS rank computed on unadjusted prices across a split
rs_leader_pullback.consequence: The rank is an artefact of bad data, not real outperformance.

signs: universe built from today's index members only
universal_failures.consequence: Backtest returns are inflated because delisted losers are missing.

signs: signal uses the same close it trades on
features computed on the full series then split
universal_failures.consequence: The backtest is reading the future. Expectancy will collapse live.

signs: unadjusted series stitched across a split
universal_failures.consequence: A 1:10 split appears as a -90% crash and corrupts every indicator.
The backtest fill price does not exist at your size.

signs: one setup tested across all regimes without separation
universal_failures.consequence: A setup that works only in trend_up shows mediocre aggregate results and gets discarded incorrectly.
